result:
I’d make it impossible to regard another person’s suffering as unreal just because they’re far away, unfamiliar, or on the other side of an argument.

Not force everyone to agree or be kind. Just remove that convenient numbness that lets people understand, intellectually, that someone is hurting while treating it as if nothing is happening.

It wouldn’t solve everything. People would still have competing needs and hard choices. But cruelty would lose one of its greatest advantages: how easy it is not to feel the cost.
